title: Sunday · twelve flyers
logline: Twelve flyers, and the Sunday spends its tiers on the pins: the tin, the hand, the twelfth pin going in. Gully's hand, not Wood's.

panels.composition: Tier 2: a stocky hand pressing a pin into a fresh flyer on shingle.

panels.name: Hand

panels.composition: Tier 3: the wall with twelve flyers, the hand gone.
